note: The rounds this project owes, as data. A date in a roadmap table is a date nobody can assert on; this file is read by eval/tools/round_clock.py on every push, so a registered round that passes its date turns CI red instead of being discovered the next time somebody reads the plan. `status` moves registered -> dispatched -> read, or to `cancelled`, which is a decision rather than a debt. Nothing here fires on a clock: two dispatches in this lane were armed on a `schedule:` trigger and neither fired (AUDIT 34.232, 34.241), so a funded action is a `workflow_dispatch` and the cron is left to the free contract job.
